title: Lalka Mod
description: Adds Lalka King boss to the End Highlands and a legendary troll sword.
body:
Lalka King is a hostile creature that spawns in End Highlands.

Drops: 1–3 Heart of Lalka King  
Crafting: Surround a Netherite Sword with 8 Hearts  
Result: The strongest sword in the universe (or is it?)

Requires GeckoLib.
